cases.title: Dynamic price and count update upon selecting available seats and changing movie
cases.description: Verify that clicking available seats updates the selected seat count in [data-testid="selected-count"] and total price in [data-testid="total-price"] based on the movie dropdown selection ([data-testid="movie-select"]), and changing the movie correctly updates the total price.

cases.title: Occupied seats are non-selectable and do not affect metrics
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a seat with the occupied class does not change its selection status, nor does it affect the selected seat count or total price.

cases.title: Select movie, toggle seats, and update localStorage
cases.description: User selects a movie from the dropdown, clicks on an available seat to toggle its selection status, verifies that the seat is visually marked as selected, and checks that its index is correctly stored in localStorage along with the updated seat count and total price.

cases.title: Prevent occupied seat selection and handle deselection
cases.description: User attempts to click on an occupied seat, verifying it cannot be selected or included in calculations, and then deselects a previously selected seat by clicking it again to verify the UI and localStorage update correctly.

cases.title: Restore selections from local storage
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the page when local storage contains 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', the corresponding seats are marked with the 'selected' class and the movie dropdown reflects the saved movie index.

cases.title: Default values when local storage is empty
cases.description: Verify that when local storage does not contain 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', no seats are marked as 'selected' and the dropdown defaults to the first movie option 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Dynamic update of seat count and total price upon selecting and deselecting seats
cases.description: Verify that clicking available seats toggles their selection, updates data-testid='selected-count', and correctly computes data-testid='total-price' based on the current ticket price. Deselecting a seat should decrease the count and total price accordingly.

cases.title: Updating movie selection after seat selection maintains seat count and recalculates total price
cases.description: Verify that when a user changes the movie from the dropdown menu (data-testid='movie-select') after seats are already selected, the total price updates based on the new ticket price while keeping the count of selected seats constant, and that occupied seats cannot be selected.

cases.title: Verify Legend Status Representation and Interaction
cases.description: Verify that legends correctly indicate available, selected, and occupied seat states, and that clicking near or on the legend elements does not trigger seat selection.

cases.title: Verify Occupied Seat Non-Interactivity and Legend Identifiers
cases.description: Validate the presence of data-testid='seat-select' or equivalent legend identifiers and ensure occupied seats are non-interactive and clearly marked.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases effectively cover the requirements for the movie seat booking application, including dynamic pricing, seat toggling, occupied seat restrictions, localStorage persistence, and legend verification. No blockers identified.
All requirements and test cases are logically sound, well-defined, and fully testable based on the provided specifications.

analysis.analysis:
Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1 normal scenario: Page load initializes seat map and movie dropdown with default values. Edge scenario: Selecting zero seats results in a zero total price. Boundary scenario: Selecting the maximum available seats calculates the correct total. Abnormal scenario: Clicking an occupied seat does not change selection status, count, or price. Actionable missing scenario: Verify exact CSS class toggling for selection states.
Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2 normal scenario: Selecting specific movies like 'The Big Lebowski ($10)' updates the ticket price and total. Edge scenario: Deselecting a previously selected seat updates localStorage and UI. Boundary scenario: Rapid sequential clicks on the same seat toggle state correctly without desync. Abnormal scenario: Attempting to select an occupied seat fails. Actionable missing scenario: Verify specific data-testid attributes for movie options.
Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3 normal scenario: Page load restores selected seats and movie index from localStorage. Edge scenario: LocalStorage contains partial keys or empty arrays. Boundary scenario: LocalStorage contains invalid index values. Abnormal scenario: LocalStorage is corrupted or blocked, falling back to default 'The Big Lebowski ($10)' and zero selected seats. Actionable missing scenario: Verify exact storage key names 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex'.
Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4 normal scenario: Changing movie after selecting seats updates the total price using the new ticket price while keeping seat count constant. Edge scenario: Switching between all available movies sequentially with a fixed set of selected seats. Boundary scenario: Selection count transitioning from single digit to double digits. Abnormal scenario: Interaction with disabled or occupied seats during rapid clicking. Actionable missing scenario: Verify real-time DOM updates for data-testid="selected-count" and data-testid="total-price".
Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5 normal scenario: Legends correctly represent available, selected, and occupied seat states. Edge scenario: Visual distinction check for contrast and layout. Boundary scenario: Clicking near the legend elements does not trigger seat selection. Abnormal scenario: Missing legend test identifiers. Actionable missing scenario: Validate presence and correctness of data-testid='seat-select' or equivalent legend identifiers.
